The course includes speaking practice in our live lessons, writing tasks aimed at improving your vocabulary, grammar and writing skill and lots of extra materials for you to watch and learn from. 

You will be asked to read a few chapters of the book BEFORE each lesson. Then during our lesson we will discuss the points raised in those chapters. Each lesson comes with useful vocabulary to focus on before the lesson, discussion questions to guide our debates and conversation and a follow-up writing task for homework. 

The Book Club course is designed to take between 6 - 8 lessons (depending on the book) but we can go at a speed which is comfortable for you, making the course longer or shorter depending on your specific needs.

- The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People by Steven Covey

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Exam Preparation Course

Before our first lesson I will ask you to complete a practice writing, reading and listening test. Then, during our first lesson we will conduct a full speaking test. I will give you detailed feedback and tell you your current level. After this we will we create a study plan so that we can achieve your IELTS goals.

pro_course_detail.title: Exam preparation - IELTS and Cambridge
pro_course_detail.description:
The classes will be focused on speaking and can be used for advice and feedback on writing. We will do practice with official test questions and past papers and I can help you find several free online sites that give you extra practice questions. There are people who have a great level of English who still get low grades in IELTS and Cambridge exams because they don't understand how the test works.
We will:
- work on vocabulary and grammar that will help you in speaking and writing parts of your exam as well as how to structure your answers.
- look at the types of questions you need to answer in the test and how to answer them.
- analyse model answers for what works in exams and look at what you can take to add to your exam answers.
- analyse your weaknesses and build a plan to help you improve them.

If you want me to help you I can create a learning plan for you to help you meet targets before your intended exam date.

I will give you an honest opinion of your level after I have learned more about your abilities and as you progress in your practice. I do not want to push people to pay for a test when they are not ready. 

Apart from the lessons you have with me it is extremely important that you are doing lots of non-exam reading and listening of suitable material to prepare for your exam. I will help you find material to read and to listen to. For example, for IELTS you will be reading academic text in the exam so I can help you find academic style websites to do reading practice with.

I can help you find listening and reading test question materials and recommend suitable books but it is not a good use of your class time to do new listening and reading test practice during the lesson. When you have a problem understanding questions in your listening and reading practice it is useful for you to bring those questions to the lesson so I can help you to learn from the problem.

Writing tasks should be completed as preparation/homework between lessons.

Individual fluency lessons with detailed feedback & correction on your errors

 You are able to go to the "FLUENCY LESSON SOFTWARE" and review your errors, SEE BELOW (grammar, pronunciation, new vocab etc)
